name: MailClient
description: Production Synapp mail client. The Wasm module is a pure planner and validator for human UI flows and AI tool invocations; the host owns account settings, protocol I/O, scheduling, and persistence.

exports.name: list_accounts
exports.description: List configured mail accounts from host-managed settings without exposing secrets.

exports.name: get_provider_capabilities
exports.description: Read host account provider policy and connector availability for user-scoped account setup.

exports.name: validate_account_setup
exports.description: Validate and normalize a user-scoped IMAP/SMTP or OAuth account setup draft without executing network I/O.

exports.name: plan_connection_test
exports.description: Plan host-owned IMAP/SMTP/folder connection test steps without performing protocol I/O in Wasm.

exports.name: complete_account_setup
exports.description: Validate and plan persistence for a user-scoped account after sanitized host connection tests.

exports.name: begin_oauth_account_setup
exports.description: Plan host-owned OAuth authorization start for a supported mail provider.

exports.name: complete_oauth_account_setup
exports.description: Convert a host-completed OAuth connection reference into a user mail account plan.

exports.name: disconnect_oauth_account
exports.description: Plan OAuth disconnect and optional account disable without removing local metadata by default.

exports.name: remove_account
exports.description: Plan removal or disablement of a user mail account and related host cleanup.

exports.name: list_identities
exports.description: Read sender identities and signatures for account settings and compose selectors.

exports.name: save_identity
exports.description: Validate and plan saving a user sender identity or alias.

exports.name: delete_identity
exports.description: Plan removal of a sender identity and default reassignment.

exports.name: save_signature
exports.description: Validate and plan saving a user mail signature.

exports.name: delete_signature
exports.description: Plan deletion of a signature and cleanup of identity defaults.

exports.name: get_user_preferences
exports.description: Read user-scoped reading, compose, notification, and sync preferences.

exports.name: save_user_preferences
exports.description: Validate and plan saving user-scoped mail preferences.

exports.name: inspect_legacy_settings
exports.description: Classify legacy settings for safe user-scoped migration without moving credentials into admin policy.

exports.name: migrate_legacy_settings
exports.description: Plan migration of legacy settings into user-scoped account and preference records.

exports.name: get_account_status
exports.description: Get sync and connection status for a configured account.

exports.name: list_mailboxes
exports.description: List standard and custom folders for one account or the unified inbox.

exports.name: read_emails
exports.description: Fetch a paginated email list for a mailbox, including thread mode, focused inbox, filters, and sort state.

exports.name: search_emails
exports.description: Run a full-text mail search with structured filters.

exports.name: get_email
exports.description: Fetch one email with full bodies, attachment metadata, and optional mark-read planning.

exports.name: get_thread
exports.description: Fetch a full conversation thread ordered for reading-pane rendering or agent inspection.

exports.name: mark_read
exports.description: Mark one or more emails read or unread.

exports.name: flag_email
exports.description: Flag or unflag emails for follow-up.

exports.name: draft_email
exports.description: Create a draft with rich body content, recipients, attachments, and signature metadata.

exports.name: update_draft
exports.description: Update an existing draft in the host draft store.

exports.name: discard_draft
exports.description: Delete a draft and clear local compose state.

exports.name: send_email
exports.description: Send a draft through the selected account with undo-send handling.

exports.name: reply_email
exports.description: Compose or send a reply or reply-all from an existing message.

exports.name: forward_email
exports.description: Compose or send a forward with explicit recipients and message note.

exports.name: move_email
exports.description: Move emails to another mailbox or custom folder.

exports.name: delete_email
exports.description: Move emails to Trash or permanently delete them.

exports.name: archive_email
exports.description: Move emails into the Archive mailbox.

exports.name: create_folder
exports.description: Create a custom folder in an account mailbox tree.

exports.name: rename_folder
exports.description: Rename an existing custom folder.

exports.name: delete_folder
exports.description: Delete a custom folder, optionally forcing when children or messages exist.

exports.name: get_unread_count
exports.description: Return unread counters per mailbox for one account or the unified inbox.

exports.name: create_rule
exports.description: Create a mail automation rule with ordered conditions and actions.

exports.name: list_rules
exports.description: List mail rules for an account.

exports.name: delete_rule
exports.description: Delete a stored mail automation rule.

exports.name: schedule_send
exports.description: Queue a draft for future delivery.

exports.name: cancel_scheduled_send
exports.description: Cancel a queued send job and restore draft editability.

hostEffects.notes: Mail account secrets and OAuth state are host-managed. The Wasm module validates requests, normalizes payloads, and returns effect plans; it never performs direct IMAP/SMTP/OAuth traffic.

ServerSecretRef.description: Opaque host-managed secret reference or one-time input reference. Raw credential values are forbidden.
